messages:
Ava: heads up — apiserver 502/503 spikes in us-east1 since 12:05 UTC, observed increased latencies and some controller-manager restarts. GPU node provisioning queues piling up.
Miguel: on it, seeing etcd leader flips: node-etcd-a -> node-etcd-d -> node-etcd-a about 5x in last 3m. RPC timeouts to followers ~1.8-2.2s.
Priya: networking pushed a BGP tweak at 12:00 for the edge routers in that region, could be noisy. tagging netops. @netops
Ava: sample apiserver logs: 
```
E0319 12:06:23.123 apiserver.go:456] http2: server handler panic: write tcp 10.12.3.5:6443->10.32.0.12:51234: write: connection reset by peer
etcdserver: leader timed out waiting for majority (rpc timeout)
```
Carlos: looks like short network blips are triggering follower catch-up and leader elections. last change to etcd election timeout was lowered to 1000ms for faster failover — that might be too aggressive under noisy net.
Miguel: agree. temporary mitigation: increase etcd --election-timeout to 5000ms and bump apiserver keepalive/backoff? also controller-manager leader election lease-duration -> 15s to reduce thrash.
Priya: I can push a configmap patch for controller-manager flags and a small daemonset to roll etcd with the env var change. but rolling etcd is risky during leader flips.
Ava: for immediate customer impact: GPU nodes in provisioning are stuck in Pending because apiserver rate-limits and watch reconnects. Can we pause GPU autoscaling to avoid more churn?
Carlos: +1, set cluster-autoscaler replicas to 0 for the region or annotate the GPU nodegroup with scale-disabled. Priya — can you do that?
Priya: will disable autoscaler for the GPU pool now and open a rollback PR.
deploy-bot: Priya started a rollout (id: r-1765437891) — scale cluster-autoscaler (us-east1-gpu) replicas: 2 -> 0.
Miguel: also recommend temporary API read-only fallback for non-critical routes (embeddings/analytics) to reduce write pressure; route to fallback model endpoint if apiserver latency > 500ms.
Ava: good call. I've added a simple feature-flag to route heavy non-p99 traffic away. monitoring: alerting to fire if etcd leader changes >3 times in 5m.
Carlos: longer-term: netops should revert the BGP tweak or add graceful drain window. Priya, can you coordinate with netops for a temporary rollback?
Priya: pinged netops (cc: @netops-team) — they're investigating and will look to revert the change if we see continued instability.
Ava: tracking actions: 1) autoscaler disabled (done) 2) controller-manager lease bump PR (in progress) 3) etcd election-timeout increase (need careful roll, Miguel to advise) 4) netops rollback (pending). Will update thread when stable. :thumbsup:
Miguel: if leader flips stop after we disable autoscaler and netops revert, we can postpone etcd rolling change. if not, we should coordinate a staged etcd restart with backups.
Ava: thanks everyone — keeping this as high priority until control plane steady.
